input.query: SELECT 'n' p, attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2) v, count(*) c FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric='hubble_flows_processed_total' AND (attr_destination LIKE '%price-service%' OR attr_source LIKE '%price-service%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%' OR attr_source LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', attr_source, attr_destination, round(avg(value),2), count(*) FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric='hubble_flows_processed_total' AND (attr_destination LIKE '%price-service%' OR attr_source LIKE '%price-service%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%mysql%' OR attr_source LIKE '%mysql%') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: Mysql-side flow counts rose roughly uniformly across all services, so there is no price-specific network fault. The price DB slowness is inside the price service. Next I'll map the call graph by joining client spans to their child server spans, to see where the latency comes from.
